author: mopsistudios
body:
Hello, my name is Mopsistudios and I was banned for hacking about six months ago. I think I should be unbanned because back then I was  a real noob and didn't understand Minecraft communities properly  and when someone made me angry on the forums I decided to hack! I have changed and matured a lot since back then and I look forward to coming back to the server (if I'm unbanned :) ) . Please seriously consider this  because it means a lot to me.
-Kind regards, Simon
